function listPosts({url,$}) {const posts=[]; $('main a[href^="/posts/"]').each((i,e)=>{const a=$(e);const u=a.attr('href');if(u && !['/posts/','/zh/posts/'].includes(u)) posts.push({url:u,title:a.find('h2,h3').first().text().trim()||a.text().trim(),publishedAt:null});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const root=$(".article-content").first().clone();root.find('script,style,nav,form,.post-comments,.comments,.upvote-button,.toast,.post-footer,.post-meta,.blog-tags').remove();return {title:$("article h1").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:root.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('.byline .author,.author-name').first().text().trim()||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 已親讀本站列表與真實文章頁；列表 main a[href^="/posts/"]，正文 .article-content，標題 article h1。正文排除互動表單、留言與導覽。
